notes.title: Game not launching
notes.content: Sorry for any issues with the game not launching, i was not aware that the game did not start. i have just put out a change that should fix the problem.

notes.title: Patch 1.1.2
notes.content: This patch adds additional colours to all tiles that help identify what side of the puzzle they are on. This will mainly help in navigating the bigger, multisided puzzles. Please message if you have any feedback.

notes.title: Patch 1.1.1
notes.content: This patch adds basic background music to the levels. If you have any feedback on the music or other features. Please put your thought in the discussion page.

notes.title: MASSIVE UPDATE IS FINALLY HERE
notes.content:
After working on the new update for Swapper Tiles for months, it has finally been finished. 
Massive Update Features, Multiple Sides are Here:
- Multiple Sides from generator
- Cube Rotation for multiple sides
- Extra Panels for showing adjacent side tiles
Extra features to improve game play for multiple sides will be coming shortly, if you want your idea added to the game. Please suggest it in the discussion.
This does not mean that it won't have bugs but I have tried to find all of them and fix the problem. If you do find bugs, please message me or create a discussion for it.

notes.title: MASSIVE UPDATE COMING SOON
notes.content:
EDIT: Sorry for delays, the update is taking way longer then expected. I am working on it and will try and get it live as quickly as possible. 14th July

There will be a massive gameplay update for Swapper Tiles in the next few days that will add the "Multiple Sides" functionality to the game. The puzzle generator will gain the ability to make puzzles on more the one side of the cube. You will be able to create on 1 - 6 sides and connect all the tiles between each side. There will also be a few levels added to the premade levels to show some of the new available puzzles. Feel free to wishlist Swapper Tiles so you can easily check when the update comes live.
If you have any questions, feel free to email me: ryndergames@gmail.com

notes.title: Demo

notes.title: Player suggestions
notes.content:
Hey everyone.
I have posted a discussion and wanted to get some ideas from players or even other people who may want to get Swapper Tiles in the future
The ideas I am wanting is for features to be added to the game. 
An idea I have heard about is have a game mode where you can swap any 2 pieces rather than the one next to it.
If you have ideas, feel free to put them in the discussion or add me on steam and message.
If people are wanting a taste of Swapper Tiles, there is a demo on our [url=ryndergames.com] Website	[/url].
